nodes.label: GLUE Home engine in Rust
nodes.rationale: Tauri 2 tray app with Rust engine (crates/glue-engine) that runs the library, analysis, sync, and DJ library management. The website on GLUE Home's computer is only its screen.

nodes.label: Analysis queue in GLUE Home
nodes.rationale: One pipeline inside songs at a time: user-asked songs first, then new songs' tags, then library songs, then background thumbnails. Counted in the window's meter.

nodes.label: WebRTC connections from GLUE Home to other devices
nodes.rationale: Rust implementation (crates/glue-rtc, webrtc-rs) for peer connections, their channels, pings, and song transfers. Offers answered through glue-rtc, candidates held.

nodes.label: GLUE Cloud room socket for signaling
nodes.rationale: WebSocket connection to GLUE Cloud's Durable Object room for presence, broadcasts, and WebRTC signals. Ping every 30s, new token at 50 minutes, back-off on reconnect.

nodes.label: Device sessions with GLUE Home
nodes.rationale: Each device's tab keeps one session with each of the account's other GLUE Homes, opened at sign-in, kept alive by ping every 15s. Max 5 at once per GLUE Home.

nodes.label: Song streaming to other devices
nodes.rationale: Songs stream by byte range through WebRTC to other devices. Service worker answers as a stream (256 KB, then 2 MB pieces). Song start timing shows connection type: direct, through router, or relay.

nodes.label: GLUE Cloud signaling and TURN relay
nodes.rationale: Connections through Cloudflare's TURN relay with owner's key when direct WebRTC is not possible. ICE credentials from GLUE Cloud, encrypted end to end.

nodes.label: GLUE folder structure and JSON store
nodes.rationale: User's data in JSON files: mco.json, profiles, collections with tracks/analysis/lists/sources, backups, cloud sync cursor. No database, kept under one writer at a time.
